about: WoW Forever Mage talents, beta client 1.60.1 (builds 69893 to 70124). Per-rank values are the client trait curves the ElliotWood sim reads, cross-checked against ForeverChanges per-rank texts (build 70124). Wowhead tooltips print stored base points and are wrong for several talents; see crossCheck. Collected 30 Sep 2026.
